segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מָזְגוּ לוֹ כּוֹס שְׁלִישִׁי מְבָרֵךְ עַל מְזוֹנוֹ. רְבִיעִי גּוֹמֵר עָלָיו אֶת הַלֵּל, וְאוֹמֵר עָלָיו בִּרְכַּת הַשִּׁיר. בֵּין הַכּוֹסוֹת הַלָּלוּ, אִם רוֹצֶה לִשְׁתּוֹת — יִשְׁתֶּה, בֵּין שְׁלִישִׁי לִרְבִיעִי — לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «They poured for» the leader of the seder «the third cup» of wine, «and he recites the blessing over his food,» Grace After Meals. Next, they pour him the «fourth» cup. «He completes hallel over it,» as he already recited the first part of hallel before the meal. «And he» also «recites the blessing of the song» at the end of hallel «over» the fourth cup. During the period «between these cups,» i.e., the first three cups established by the Sages, «if one wishes to drink» more «he» may «drink;» however, «between the third» cup «and the fourth» cup one should «not drink.»

moves.summary: order of the third and fourth cups

positions.claim: Grace over the third cup, hallel and blessing of song over the fourth; no drinking between the third and fourth
